title: 第21章 这是什么东西第22章 这是只肥羊
lines: 离开葬剑谷已有数日，云澈沿着荒凉的山道一路向西南而行。
越往前走，人烟渐渐多了起来，偶尔能见到赶着驮兽的商队或是风尘仆仆的独行客。
空气中的灵气依旧稀薄，但那股萦绕不散的死寂之气已然消失，取而代之的是一种粗糙而充满活力的烟火气。
这一日，翻过一道低矮的山梁，眼前豁然开朗。
一座巨大的城池，如同匍匐在大地上的钢铁巨兽，出现在视野尽头。
城墙并非寻常的砖石结构，而是由一种泛着暗沉金属光泽的黑色巨石垒成，高耸陡峭，在阳光下反射着冷硬的光。
无数高矮不一的烟囱林立其间，冒着滚滚浓烟，空气中弥漫着一股硫磺、煤烟和金属熔炼混合的刺鼻气味。
远远便能听到城内传来的叮叮当当、连绵不绝的打铁声和机械运转的轰鸣。
“黑铁城……终于到了。”
云澈站在山坡上，望着这座闻名遐迩的混乱之城，眼神凝重。
根据他从青岚宗了解到的零星信息，黑铁城位于凡剑域边缘，是三域交界、三不管的法外之地。
因其周边蕴藏着丰富的各类矿产，尤其是一种名为“黑纹铁”
的低阶灵矿，吸引了无数淘金者、亡命徒和大小势力在此扎根，形成了以矿产开采、武器锻造和灰色交易为主的独特生态。
这里没有统一的秩序，拳头和灵石就是硬道理。
云澈深吸了一口带着金属味的空气，压下心中初来乍到的些许忐忑，将气息收敛到最低，让自己看起来像个普通的、修为低微的流浪剑徒，这才迈步朝着那巨大的城门走去。
城门口并无严格盘查，只有几个穿着杂乱、眼神彪悍的守卫懒洋洋地靠在门洞边，目光如鹰隼般扫视着进出的人流，偶尔对某些看起来肥羊的家伙露出不怀好意的笑容。
云澈混在人群中，低调地进入城内。
一进城，喧嚣和混乱便扑面而来。
宽阔的街道两旁店铺林立，但大多简陋粗犷，招牌歪斜，售卖的东西从各种矿石毛坯、半成品的刀剑铠甲，到来历不明的妖兽材料、低阶丹药，应有尽有。
行人更是鱼龙混杂，有身穿统一服饰、气息不弱的宗门弟子，有浑身肌肉、扛着铁锤的壮汉，有眼神阴鸷、独来独往的冒险者，甚至还能看到一些气息与人类迥异的妖族混迹其中。
云澈敏锐地察觉到，这城中行走的剑修，平均水准确实比青岚宗外门要高上一截。
剑徒后期随处可见，甚至偶尔能感受到剑师级别的强横气息一闪而过。
他心中更加警惕，在这里，自己这点微末修为，必须步步为营。
他首先需要解决的是灵石问题。
在葬剑谷中，他除了猎杀妖兽，也顺手采集了一些在谷底阴湿处生长的低阶灵草，如“阴凝草”
、“蚀骨花”
之类，虽然品相一般，但在这资源匮乏的边缘地带，应该能换点钱。
他找到一家看起来还算规矩的药材铺，将几株用布包好的灵草取出。
掌柜是个精瘦的中年人，漫不经心地拨弄了几下，报出了一个低得离谱的价格。
“就这品相，五块下品灵石，爱卖不卖。”
云澈眉头微皱，他知道对方在压价，但初来乍到，不想节外生枝。
他沉默片刻，用平静但不容置疑的语气道：
“八块。
这些‘阴凝草’年份足，保存尚可，这个价公道。”
那掌柜有些意外地抬眼看了看这个衣着破旧、面色苍白的少年，没想到对方还挺懂行。
他撇撇嘴，似乎懒得为这点小钱纠缠：“七块，不行拿走。”
“成交。”
content_en:
A few days after leaving the Sword Burial Valley, Yun Che walked southwest along the desolate mountain road.
As we go further, the number of people gradually increases, and occasionally we can see caravans driving pack animals or lonely travelers who have traveled a long way.
The spiritual energy in the air is still thin, but the lingering air of death has disappeared, replaced by a rough and energetic smoke and smoke.
On this day, when I climbed over a low mountain ridge, my eyes suddenly opened up.
A huge city, like a steel behemoth crawling on the ground, appeared at the end of the field of vision.
The city wall is not an ordinary masonry structure, but is made of a black boulder with a dull metallic luster. It is tall and steep, reflecting cold light in the sun.
Countless chimneys of varying heights stood among them, emitting thick smoke, and the air was filled with a pungent smell of sulfur, soot and metal smelting.
From a distance, you can hear the clanging sounds, the continuous sound of forging iron, and the roar of machinery coming from the city.
"Black Iron City... finally arrived."
Yun Che stood on the hillside, looking at this famous chaotic city with solemn eyes.
According to the fragmentary information he learned from the Qinglan Sect, Black Iron City is located on the edge of the Mortal Sword Territory. It is a lawless place at the junction of the three realms.
Because its surroundings are rich in various minerals, especially a kind of "black grained iron"
The low-level spiritual mines have attracted countless gold prospectors, desperadoes, and forces of all sizes to take root here, forming a unique ecosystem dominated by mineral mining, weapon forging, and gray trading.
There is no unified order here, fists and spirit stones are the last word.
Yun Che took a deep breath of the metallic-smelling air, suppressed the initial uneasiness in his heart, and restrained his breath to the lowest level, making himself look like an ordinary wandering swordsman with low cultivation, and then he walked towards the huge city gate.
There was no strict inspection at the city gate. There were only a few guards in messy clothes and fierce eyes leaning lazily against the door opening, scanning the flow of people in and out like hawks, and occasionally showing malicious smiles to some guys who looked like fat sheep.
Yun Che blended into the crowd and quietly entered the city.
As soon as you enter the city, you are greeted by hustle and bustle.
There are many shops on both sides of the wide street, but most of them are simple and crude, with crooked signboards. They sell everything from various ore roughs, semi-finished swords and armors, to monster materials of unknown origin and low-level elixirs.
The pedestrians were a mixed bag, including sect disciples wearing uniform clothes and strong auras, muscular men carrying hammers, solitary adventurers with sinister eyes, and even some monsters with auras that were completely different from humans mixed in.
Yun Che was keenly aware that the average level of sword cultivators walking in this city was indeed higher than that of the outer sect of Qinglan Sect.
Swordsman disciples can be seen everywhere in the later stage, and you can even occasionally feel the tyrannical aura of the sword master level passing by.
He was even more vigilant. Here, with his meager cultivation, he had to take care of himself step by step.
The first thing he needs to solve is the spirit stone problem.
In the Sword Burial Valley, in addition to hunting monsters, he also collected some low-level spiritual grasses that grew in the damp places at the bottom of the valley, such as "Yin Ning grass"
, "Bone-eating Flower"
Although the quality is average, it should be able to exchange for some money in this fringe area where resources are scarce.
He found a decent-looking medicine shop and took out a few spiritual herbs wrapped in cloth.
The shopkeeper was a lean middle-aged man. He fiddled with it carelessly a few times and quoted an absurdly low price.
"Just this appearance, five pieces of low-grade spiritual stones, sell them if you like."
Yun Che frowned slightly. He knew that the other party was lowering the price, but he was new here and didn't want to cause trouble.
He was silent for a moment and said in a calm but unquestionable tone:
"Eight dollars.
These 'Yin Ning Cao' are old enough and can be preserved well. The price is fair. "
The shopkeeper looked up at the young man in shabby clothes and pale face with some surprise. Unexpectedly, he was quite knowledgeable.
He pouted, as if he was too lazy to bother with this small amount of money: "Seven yuan, you can't take it away."
"Deal."
